_help: Wooden sign board geometry in 1366x768 space (saves + server screens). slice/overlapTop/botUp seal the top-middle-bottom joints. bodyPadTop/bodyPadBottom frame the rows; middleExtraH grows the middle (rows stay centered). listSize/cancelSize are display px (text is NOT shrunk by scale); textMargin/textGap/textDown/cancelDown are menu px (shrunk by scale). Keys may be omitted (keeps current value). DEBUG builds reload this file live on save.
